name: Steps trial
purpose: Measures, per trial, how far someone gets through the steps without help.
record: Not recorded by a run yet; noted per trial by hand as metric-steps-followed describes.

name: Local index lookup cases
purpose: Measures whether a lookup finds the project, its first file and its relations for a world of projects the guidance never named.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each implementation on the same cases, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash.
command: esoi run index_projects --impl live_index; esoi run index_projects --impl skill_rows; esoi run index_projects --impl records_only

name: ESOI behaviour cases
purpose: Measures whether an agent's reply acts by the principle each case tests, for each way of giving the agent the principles. The arms that call a model are not measured yet, so it does not show how much the skill changes behaviour or which way of giving it is best.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each arm on the same cases and sample, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash; the headline lists passes per principle.

name: ESOI judge agreement cases
purpose: Measures how often a judge's verdict equals the label of the recorded reply it graded, with false passes and false fails apart. The model judge is not measured yet and every label is the case author's, so agreement cannot show calibration against a person.
record: Replies graded as labelled out of replies graded for each judge on the same cases and sample, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash; the headline lists both error kinds and the labels that are a person's.
